meta.methodology: Priority score combines empirical rank with absolute severity: 35% aggregate discount, 28% quarter deterioration, 18% audited same-facility disagreement, 12% exposure materiality, and 7% cross-fund breadth. Discount, deterioration, and disagreement reach full intensity at 20, 10, and 10 percentage points, respectively. A verified senior-first fund-pair breach adds five points. It is a triage tool, not a credit rating.
meta.pairwise_lead_lag_methodology: Fund-pair lead-lag tests aggregate only within issuer, fund, quarter, and explicit capital tier. Each junior-fund versus senior-fund pair requires at least $1mm of cost in each tier and two common quarters. First crossings below 95% and 90% of cost are reported without pooling lenders.

deep_discount.label: Deep discount
deep_discount.description: Aggregate fair value is below 90% of amortized cost.

below_cost.label: Below cost
below_cost.description: Aggregate fair value is between 90% and 97% of amortized cost.

rapid_deterioration.label: Rapid deterioration
rapid_deterioration.description: Aggregate FV/cost fell at least 5 percentage points from the prior observed quarter.

emerging_deterioration.label: Emerging deterioration
emerging_deterioration.description: Aggregate FV/cost fell 2-5 percentage points from the prior observed quarter.

audited_disagreement.label: Audited disagreement
audited_disagreement.description: Matched first-lien facilities differ by at least 5 points of FV/principal across funds.

crowded.label: Crowded exposure
crowded.description: At least four verified BDCs hold the normalized issuer.

senior_first.label: Senior moved first
senior_first.description: An explicit fund-pair test shows first-lien debt crossed below 95% before junior capital.

junior_first.label: Junior moved first
junior_first.description: An explicit fund-pair test shows junior capital crossed below 95% before first-lien debt.

stable_context.label: Context
stable_context.description: No primary triage threshold is currently breached.
